text: ポケモンに　のってる　なんて　もしかして　およげない　とか？

structure.jp: ポケモンに　のってる　なんて
structure.en: riding on a Pokémon, of all things

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.explanation: なんて after a phrase holds it up with surprise or a sneer, like 'the very idea of'. のってる　なんて = 'riding on one, of all things'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending changes 'swim' into 'can swim', and ない makes it 'cannot'. およげない = 'can't swim'.

patterns.name: 〜とか
patterns.explanation: とか at the end makes a guess vague, like 'or something'. およげない　とか？ = 'you can't swim or something?'
